title: Maash ki Sookhi Daal (Dry White Lentils)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A delicate dry daal of white lentils, adapted from the author's sister Sughra. Pairs with saucy curries and bread; he's firm that it doesn't belong with rice.

steps.action: Rinse a few times in a large pot with cold water; drain well:
Add and bring to a boil on high:
items: Half of: 2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), peeled, in ⅛ in (3 mm) dice

steps.action: Cover at once; cook on low (2/10) 30 min.
Stir; it should be dry, like cooked rice. If water shows, cook covered 5 min more and repeat.
Tarka: heat in a small frying pan over high, 2 min:
Add and fry, stirring often, 5+ min, until light brown:
items: 1 small onion (4 oz / 110 g), halved and finely sliced

steps.action: Add and fry 1 min, stirring constantly:
Pour into the daal and mix. Adjust salt.
